chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Registration- cum- Membership Certificate (RCMC)

business_rules.rule_description:
On being admitted to membership, applicant shall be granted
forthwith Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC) of EPC concerned, in
pg.

member of EPC.
